activePains.symptom: Transitioning across levels via global top tabs dumps all cards/tasks at that depth rather than allowing the user to walk down a specific pillar's subtree
activePains.rootCause: Lack of pillar-focused tree navigation that filters Level 2 and Level 3 views to a selected pillar path

resolvedPains.symptom: Raw spec lines mix dense technical trivia (Pillow, frame_count=1, FrameRef) forcing reviewers to re-read multiple times without understanding the human meaning
resolvedPains.rootCause: Lack of an automated Plain-English Intent Translator layer that separates 'What it means for the product' from 'Technical implementation trivia'
resolvedPains.resolution: Implemented Plain-English Intent Translator Engine in DashboardView.tsx with 💬 Plain English Mode toggle

resolvedPains.symptom: Cards feel like packaged text dumps; descriptions contain cryptic jargon and cards still display full lists of raw markdown bullet lines
resolvedPains.rootCause: Cards lack plain-English intent summaries and key invariant extraction; raw spec lines are displayed upfront instead of collapsed into detail drawers
resolvedPains.resolution: Redesigned cards with 1-sentence Plain-English Goals, 2-3 Key Structural Chips, and default-collapsed detail drawers in DashboardView.tsx

resolvedPains.symptom: Transitioning from Zoom Level 1 (Skyline) to Zoom Level 2 (Neighborhoods) presents a wall of dense text and decisions that is hard to scan
resolvedPains.rootCause: Lack of visual spatial clustering and risk-based noise filtering at Zoom Level 2
resolvedPains.resolution: Implemented Neighborhood Cluster Cards (Idea 02), Scaffolding Dimmer (Idea 06), and Risk Indexing (Idea 05) in DashboardView.tsx

resolvedPains.symptom: Agent harness UI froze in typing state when agent process timed out or threw unhandled socket errors
resolvedPains.rootCause: Missing try-catch and timeout safeguards in AgentService socket events
resolvedPains.resolution: Added 45s timeout race condition and explicit chat_reply_error and autofix_error event emitters
